coverage.note: structural coverage (paper Def 10): a node is covered when it is in the annotations and all its outgoing edges are; leaf exits feed junction edges that only the compositions and the root hold, so leaves alone cannot cover their exits

structures.name: S1
structures.title: 0-vs-6 separator (S1)
structures.hypothesis: 0-vs-6 separator (S1): Combines S1.1 (Closed-loop detector), S1.2 (No-stem detector · without an open left side), S1.3 (0/2/3/5/6/8 structure (mechanism unknown) (S1.3)) and S1.4 (Weak closed-left-side detector). S1.1 feeds S1.2; S1.2 feeds S1.3 and S1.4. Together they separate 0s from 6s (94% balanced accuracy, cross-validated) much better than the best part alone (S1.4: 79%). Its strongest exit (map h119): correlates with 0s, 2s, 3s, 5s, 6s and 8s; mechanism unknown: no image rule explains it within digits (closest: a tall vertical stem, s = -0.68). It fires on 0s (93%), 2s (83%), 8s (78%), 3s (74%), 6s (70%), 5s (64%) and 9s (51%). Evidence: Overall s = -0.68; within digits s = -0.54 on average over 7 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = -0.10; add_stem edit: -0.22 SD against its control (as predicted).

structures.name: S2
structures.title: No-stem detector (S2)
structures.hypothesis: No-stem detector (S2): It responds when the image lacks a tall vertical stem: it is held back by a long, near-vertical stroke running most of the digit's height. So it fires on 3s (99%), 2s (97%), 5s (96%), 0s (87%), 8s (84%), 6s (67%), 7s (67%) and 9s (59%), and on 4s that have no tall vertical stem (51% vs 3% without). Evidence: Overall s = -0.80; within digits s = -0.75 on average over 7 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = -0.43; add_stem edit: -1.34 SD against its control (as predicted).

structures.name: S3
structures.title: 7/8/9 structure (mechanism unknown)

It fires on no class most of the time. Evidence: Overall s = +0.07; within digits s = +0.04 on average over 3 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = +0.14.

structures.name: S4
structures.title: No-left-open-upper-curve detector
structures.hypothesis: No-left-open-upper-curve detector: It responds when the image lacks an upper curve open to the left: it is held back by an upper curve that opens to the left, ink above, below and to its right (the top of a 2, 3 or 7). So it fires on 6s (99%), 5s (99%), 1s (98%), 0s (97%), 8s (76%) and 4s (53%), and on 2s that have no upper curve open to the left (53% vs 23% without). Evidence: Overall s = -0.75; within digits s = -0.29 on average over 4 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = -0.56; close_upper edit: +1.10 SD against its control (as predicted); open_upper edit: -0.56 SD against its control (as predicted).

annotations.name: root
annotations.title: Digit scores from the structures
annotations.hypothesis: Digit scores from the structures: Reads the structures' exits through the ten score maps and the head: each score map is a sum of kernels on the exits (and on the image directly), averaged over the map, and the head mixes the ten averages into the class scores (exact, linear). The largest direct push towards each image's own digit (score margin over the mean score, on images of that digit): '0' by 3-vs-8 separator (S8) (+21.11); '1' by 3-vs-8 separator (S8) (+4.98); '2' by Left-open upper-curve detector (+11.10); '3' by Left-open upper-curve detector (+13.48); '4' by 3-vs-8 separator (S8) (+7.60); '5' by No-left-open-upper-curve detector (+13.67); '6' by No-left-open-upper-curve detector (+14.36); '7' by Left-open upper-curve detector (+9.76); '8' by 0-vs-6 separator (S1) (+8.28); '9' by 3-vs-8 separator (S8) (+7.87).

suggester.method: attribution flow (gradient x input per edge, all class scores) + activation similarity (r >= 0.8); greedy merging that keeps the groups a DAG (5-8 structures); sub-parts by the same score inside each structure (at most 4 maps each)
